summary: VisionWave Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 29, 2026, reporting entry into a binding Acquisition Agreement to acquire 51% of Meteor Aerospace Ltd., an Israeli aerospace and defense company. The transaction values Meteor at a $40.0 million pre-money equity valuation. Consideration is approximately $20.4 million, comprising $6.0 million in unrestricted VisionWave common stock and $14.4 million in restricted common stock subject to a six-month lock-up. The share count will be based on a five-day VWAP prior to closing. Closing conditions include a live flight validation of Meteor's Impact-700 UAS, completion of due diligence, and other customary conditions. Upon closing, VisionWave will appoint three of five directors, designate the Chairman, and approve major actions. Watch for the flight validation milestone and any regulatory or due diligence delays.
